lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: It's happening!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I was invited to a movie premiere!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: But they want me to write a review after watching it.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: The only thing is that

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I find it quite difficult to watch and analyze the movie.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: To be honest, I know nuts about what people mean by film aesthetics

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: and I've got to stare at a blurry screen for two hours straight.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: What should I do?
Can't you give your ticket to someone else?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: No can do. The ticket is non-transferable.
Why don't you just skip it?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: But...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: the reason I was invited is that my all-time favorite radio station

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: had selected the story I submitted.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: They said that they'd love to feature my movie review on their next show,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: and I'd really love to give it a try.
How about writing a review that focuses on the movie's audio experience?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I could, but I don't think that'd really count as watching the film in its entirety.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Is it okay to write a review like that?
If nothing else, it'd be something novel.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: While others are focusing on the visuals,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I'll be concentrating on the sound design, such as the music, sound effects, and dialogue.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: It's definitely something I have great appreciation for.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Thanks for the advice,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I've never truly experienced the pleasure of watching movies or TV shows

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: because of my poor eyesight.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: However, by shifting my perspective in that direction,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I just might find a new way to enjoy them!
That's great to hear!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Yes! Hehe.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: So...

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Are you free this weekend?

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: I was given a pair of tickets for the premiere.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Initially, I was planning to ask Poli or Miranda,

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: but I would love to attend it with you if you don't mind, Commander.
Of course. I'd love to go.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Really?!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: Then, I'll send you more details later.

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: This is the first time I've ever been so excited to watch a movie, hehe!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: See you then!
See ya!
